statements.impact_statement: /usr/local/lib/postgresql/pgxml.so links libxslt and loads only on CREATE EXTENSION xml2, which backend/schema.sql never issues. /usr/bin/xsltproc is a CLI nothing in the image invokes.
Same unreached paths as CVE-2026-125350: pgxml.so behind an extension the schema never creates, and an xsltproc nothing invokes.

The fault is in the brotli decoder. brotli-libs is in the alpine base as a libcurl dependency. This image holds the library with nothing that calls it, and no layer of ours decodes brotli.
The fault is reached by an HTTP/2 upload. This image carries libcurl without the curl binary, and the server it runs makes no outbound HTTP request.
